## Behavior

Describe the problem, before/after behavior, and linked issue or spec.

## Validation

List commands run and fresh results, regression tests added, and coverage evidence
with its limitations. Explain any checks not run.

## Risks

Describe compatibility, trust/security, asynchronous failure handling, dependencies,
package or operational changes, and any remaining manual/account prerequisites.

- [ ] `npm run check:quality` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Applicable browser/isolated host checks and coverage were run.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility aliases are preserved or changes explained.
- [ ] No secrets or private vulnerability details are included.
